title: Editor can't infer the class of a custom resource with a non-`class_name`-line script while quick loading.
body: ### Tested versions -Reproducible in: 4.5.1-stable ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable (f62fdbde1) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon (TM) 780M Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21001.9024) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840H w/ Radeon(TM) 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 31.30 GiB memory ### Issue description I have a custom class, `CustomRes`, extends `Resource`. Then I created 2 resources, in one of which I changed its script to a different new one(with some methods overrided). The new script states `extends CustomRes`, but doesn't has a `class_name` line. When I try to quick load the custom resources in a scene with `@export var custom_res : CustomRes`, the editor only provides me with the script-unchanged CustomRes resource. The resource with a different script is ignored. However, the resource with a different script can still be dragged into the export custom_res slot. --- I think this is not good. The new script clearly declared it extends from the origin class, but the resource with it failed to get recognized in the editor's quick load. I expect the custom resource with a new script (declaring it extends to the origin class) can still get inferred by the editor and can be quick loaded. This could be useful when I create many custom resources while some of them have special scripts for specific functions, and thus these custom resources can be equally treated when quick loaded. ### Steps to reproduce Open the mrp project. Open test.tscn, and try `Quick Load` of `Custom Res` in the Inspector ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-resource-class-inferring.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23762392/mrp-resource-class-inferring.zip)
